name: KAR Delivery Squad
notes: No workspace_id / runtime_id / repo URL / token / human name is included.
bootstrap.py creates or updates Skills, Agents, Squad, and uploads Skill supporting files.
Template source is the kar-doc-template skill; projects do not configure a template path.
Project description is a thin squad-overlay; defaults come from kar-squad-profile.
v4.2: candidate freeze + manifest.py check, gate checks/rationale/conditions, metrics.py, human_wip.py, restore.py.
v4.3: policy.py (artifact matrix, R3 security overlay, draft checkpoint/steer, Lead touchpoint budget), /tour, 1-page quickstart.
Backups include Skill supporting files and can be replayed with restore.py.
Old workspace skills S01-S17 are not deleted; rebind agents to v4.3 skills and archive old ones manually after verification.
